groups.defect: The missing-backup-codes message directs users to an unavailable settings recovery action, leaving existing 2FA users with an impossible instruction.
groups.rationale: Both describe the same dead-end instruction and missing regeneration capability. One points at the translation and the other at its login consumer.

groups.defect: The backup-code tests do not validate actual code contents, including clipboard output, and the copy handler reports success without awaiting the clipboard write.
groups.rationale: The broader content-validation finding explicitly includes missing clipboard-text assertions, overlapping the copy-test finding. The merged comment must retain the broader code-content coverage and the copy-specific false-success behavior.

groups.defect: Both backup-code validators use non-constant-time comparisons, and the disable endpoint additionally throws on non-string backup-code input.
groups.rationale: Both report the same comparison mistake repeated in login and disable verification, requiring changes at both sites. The disable finding also reports an input-type failure that must survive consolidation.

groups.defect: The BackupCode component is incorrectly declared with the function name TwoFactor.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same declaration and the same misleading component identity; one rename resolves both.
